clips.title: The story
paras: Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment is a crate of high-grade metal prepared specifically for the smith Jordan Stilwell. Acquired as part of a paladin's sacred trials, it provides the essential stock needed to forge a holy weapon of virtue.

When Jordan Stilwell set out to forge a weapon worthy of a dedicated paladin, ordinary stock would not suffice. The blacksmith required an assortment of rare and exacting components: a Purified Kor Gem, sturdy Whitestone Oak lumber, his own lost smithing hammer, and a specialized shipment of refined ore. This consignment represents the metal foundation for that sacred labor, brought to Ironforge to complete the Test of Righteousness.
